_note: Player tips (ROADMAP M4 session 33). Each tip shows once, the first time its moment comes, while the player's "Show player tips" option is on; tips seen are remembered in the options, not the save. moment: where the game asks for a tip (edit_units_open: Edit Units opens; map_open: the map shows with nothing over it, after the opening Edit Units, or at the start of a Quick start game; encounter_open: the encounter dialog before a fight shows; squad_menu_open: a squad's menu opens; time_started: time first runs in a game (the player unpauses); battle_over: a battle's results show; fight_started: a battle begins playing (the tip pauses it, its controls showing); town_liberated, tower_liberated: the liberation window for one opens; neutral_met: the window for meeting a neutral band opens, Recruit, Fight or Sneak past). anchor: the part of the screen the popup points at (recruit_pool: the Recruits list in Edit Units; deploy_button: the toolbar's Deploy Squad; garrison_town: the town Quick start's Garrison holds, on the map, framed with your base first; panel: the liberation window, the encounter dialog or the neutral band's window; actions: the squad menu's row of buttons; results: the end-of-battle panel; tactic: the battle's Tactic menu; speed: the game speed menu under the minimap). needs: a fact the tip waits for (flyer: the army has a flying unit; enemy:<class>: that class is in the enemy squad of the battle under way). modes: game modes it shows in (single_map, campaign, quick_start); missing means all. {town} in a tip's text is the Garrison's town. Tips are offered in this order.

build_squad.text: To begin creating a new squad, drag a leader into an empty slot. To add to a squad, drag any unit into an active squad slot.

flyers.text: You have a flying unit. Flyers can't take buildings: a squad needs at least one unit on foot to liberate a town, tower or temple.

march.text: The enemy's Garrison holds {town}, close to your base. Click your squad at the Player Base to open its menu, choose Move (the footprints), then click {town} twice to send it there. Press Space to start time.

deploy.text: Use the deploy button to send your squads out into the field of battle after composing them in the edit units screen. Conquering buildings will provide bonuses and abilities.

first_battle.text: A fight is about to begin. Heal uses herbs and Revival Draughts on this squad first. View Squad and Map pauses and puts this aside, so you can shop, heal, change the formation (Edit squad) or move other squads; it comes back when you resume. Begin Battle opens the battle, where you choose a tactic and press Fight.

first_town.text: Your reputation will rise if you liberate towns with positively aligned characters. Towns that you control at the end of the day cycle will provide income to help your empire thrive. Some towns also feature shops, indicated by a dollar symbol on the roof of their icon.

first_tower.text: Your reputation will rise if you liberate towers with negatively aligned characters. Towers that you control at the end of the day cycle will provide income to help your armies grow in power. Some towers also feature shops.

squad_menu.text: A squad's orders: edit it, heal it (the red cross), shop, move, fire at a nearby enemy, or send it home. Hover over a button to see what it does, or why it's greyed out.

healing.text: Hurt or fallen units can be healed: open the squad's menu and press Heal (the red cross) to use Herbs and Revival Draughts anywhere, or stand in a temple to pay for healing and reviving there.

tactics.text: Note: Some squads require different tactics than others. Try switching your squad's tactics to leader here.

time_controls.text:
You can use this menu to adjust the speed of the game and to pause it.

Alternatively, you can use PgUp and PgDn to adjust speed up and down and hit the space bar to pause and resume.

The 'skip to action' button beside it advances the game until one of your squads encounters an interruption in their current status, such as an arrival at a destination, a battle, or an encounter with a neutral party.

neutral_met.text: In the course of your travels, you will encounter unallied units. These groups might be persuaded to join your cause, or they might prove violent. It is up to you whether to try and engage or to do your best to avoid them. Be warned - neutral parties can vary in power greatly, and can prove to be a great asset or a source of great pain to your army.
